raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fix quantization configuration matching for fused layer names such as `attn.qkv`. Settings for the separate Q, K and V layers now apply to the combined layer.

## Claims

- Recognize fused names containing dots, including Qwen2.5 Omni and Cohere ASR mappings.
- Match whole names and leave earlier parts of the layer name unchanged.
- Keep direct layer-name matches unchanged. Continue checking that settings agree across the individual layers combined into a fused layer.

## Validation

`.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/quantization/test_config_utils.py -q`

| Code | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Original, with regression tests | 4 failed, 20 passed |
| Patched | 24 passed |

Tested `Qwen/Qwen2.5-Omni-3B` on a Tesla T4 with a custom online FP8 configuration. Before the fix, settings that targeted the separate Q, K and V layers left `visual.blocks.0.attn.qkv` unquantized. After the fix, the combined layer uses the intended FP8 method. On three image prompts, its generated tokens match those from targeting the combined layer directly.

<details>
<summary>Validation setup and reproduction commands</summary>

Tests used vLLM commit [a3e0243b1](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/a3e0243b1c3ea313b902a43b0f6559fb4148ff81) as the starting version. Original and patched tests used the same Linux environment. Final source edits changed only the explanatory comment.

Model revision: `f75b40e3da2003cdd6e1829b1f420ca70797c34e`. FP16 weights, online `fp8_per_tensor` targeting, max model length 1024, batch size 1, eager execution. The model was run four times. With both the original code and the patched code, one run targeted the combined QKV layer directly and another targeted the separate Q, K and V layers. All four runs identified all three colors correctly. Both patched runs matched the original direct-target reference, with a maximum selected-token log-probability difference of 0.0.

This checks model loading, quantization selection and generation on three prompts.

All applicable pre-commit checks on the final two-file change passed. The manual mypy-3.12 check also passed.

Model reproduction commands are shown below. Run each command in a separate process using the script included with the [validation evidence](https://gist.github.com/Festyve/cf06574abbe4fa02d9b792934418680a):
```
PYTHONPATH=/content/vllm .venv/bin/python /content/validate_fused_names_gpu.py --mode direct --expected quantized --output /content/baseline-direct.json
PYTHONPATH=/content/vllm .venv/bin/python /content/validate_fused_names_gpu.py --mode shards --expected unquantized --output /content/baseline-shards.json
# Apply production-code patch.
PYTHONPATH=/content/vllm .venv/bin/python /content/validate_fused_names_gpu.py --mode shards --expected quantized --output /content/patched-shards.json
PYTHONPATH=/content/vllm .venv/bin/python /content/validate_fused_names_gpu.py --mode direct --expected quantized --output /content/patched-direct.json
```

</details>

## Details

The old lookup reduced `visual.blocks.0.attn.qkv` to `qkv`, missing the mapping stored as `attn.qkv`. The fix checks the full mapping key at the end of the layer name, requiring a preceding dot when more of the name comes before it. It replaces only that ending, avoiding changes to repeated names earlier in the string.

Open-PR searches on 2026-10-08 found no equivalent fix. #48564 changes WeightsMapper remapping, a different code path.

Note: AI assistance was used for the implementation, but I validated, reviewed and tested the changes to make sure they're all good!

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
